text.offer: The herb gatherers won't go into the Valley of Ileria any more. Fungus beasts have spread all through it, and their spores make a body sick for days. Clear ten of them and the valley might be safe to walk again.
text.progress: The Valley of Ileria is east of Marion.
text.complete: The gatherers send their thanks - and a little coin, which I'm passing on to you.
